name: Wounded Ancients
summary: Goblin weapons may be poisoning the treants in the Stonetalon Mountains. Kaela Shadowspear asks you to gather shrapnel from the maddened guardians for Gaxim Rustfizzle to study.

sections.title: Blighted Protectors
sections.body: The treants once guarded Stonetalon's groves, fierce in defense and bound to the land's health. When the Venture Company came with buzzsaws, explosives, and strip-mining, the forest fought back. The treants drove the invaders from parts of the vale, but they did not return to their peaceful watch. Now they are hostile and maddened.

sections.title: Gnomish Investigation
sections.body: Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout in the mountains, believes no natural sickness afflicts the treants. Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer, suspects goblin weapons and chemicals harmed them during the Venture Company's chaotic retreat. He hopes corroded shrapnel from the wounded treants will show whether Venture Company ordnance is poisoning Stonetalon's ancient protectors.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Wounded Ancients?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout in the Stonetalon Mountains, asks for your help. She watches the growing conflict and the harm it brings to the land.
Gaxim Rustfizzle suspects Venture Company munitions lodged in the treants during the goblins' chaotic retreat. He believes the weapons are poisoning and maddening the forest guardians.

faq.q: What item must be retrieved for this task?
faq.answer: Recover a piece of Corroded Shrapnel from the bark and flesh of the wounded treants wandering the area.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome engineer allied with the Alliance who helps Kaela Shadowspear. He uses his mechanical skill to study Venture Company weapons and their harm to natural life.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company's presence in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a goblin logging and mining syndicate that invaded Stonetalon. It cuts sacred woodlands and plunders mineral deposits without regard for the land's balance.

faq.q: Does collecting the shrapnel heal the treants?
faq.answer: No. Gaxim needs the shrapnel as a sample to learn the toxin's nature and origin. Collecting it does not immediately cure the corrupted guardians.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei sworn to protect Kalimdor's wilds, you see goblin industry twisting ancient woodland guardians. It is an outrage.
Gaxim Rustfizzle shows how mechanical skill can reveal and explain the harm reckless engineers cause.
Treants carry nature's life within them. Removing the foreign metal poisoning their flesh is grim work as you face the Venture Company's destruction.
The corroded metal in the treants reveals the careless work behind Venture Company munitions. Gnomish craft brings a different measure of precision.
